Data Design ### 6.1 Eurostat Read Model The app reads the already-verified series view. No new Zetaris object is required. ```sql SELECT period, unemployment_rate_pct FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table ORDER BY period ``` Metadata query: ```sql SELECT dataset_label, dataset_source, last_updated FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_metadata_table ``` Period existence probe: ```sql SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table WHERE period = ? ``` The app sorts and paginates in Java. This avoids relying on `LIMIT`, `OFFSET`, `MIN`, or `MAX` support in the Zetaris SQL dialect, and the dataset is only 356 rows. ### 6.2 App-Owned H2 Schema `schema.sql` is idempotent and runs on every startup: ```sql CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS series_notes ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, period VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL, note_text VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, tag VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, rating INT, pinned BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_series_notes_period UNIQUE (period), CONSTRAINT ck_series_notes_period CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(period, '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')), CONSTRAINT ck_series_notes_rating CHECK (rating IS NULL OR rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), CONSTRAINT ck_series_notes_tag CHECK (tag IN ('GENERAL', 'MILESTONE', 'ANOMALY', 'WATCH')), CONSTRAINT ck_series_notes_note CHECK (LENGTH(TRIM(note_text)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000) ); ``` `UNIQUE (period)` enforces one annotation per month. The service maps the resulting `DataIntegrityViolationException` to a friendly form error rather than a stack trace. ### 6.3 Repository SQL Insert and return the generated key: ```sql INSERT INTO series_notes (period, note_text, tag, rating, pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ``` Update (the period is immutable after creation): ```sql UPDATE series_notes SET note_text = ?, tag = ?, rating = ?, pinned = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? ``` Delete: ```sql DELETE FROM series_notes WHERE id = ? ``` List, pinned first then newest first: ```sql SELECT id, period, note_text, tag, rating, pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM series_notes ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC ``` Find one: ```sql SELECT id, period, note_text, tag, rating, pinned, created_at, updated_at FROM series_notes WHERE id = ? ``` Duplicate probe: ```sql SELECT COUNT(*) FROM series_notes WHERE period = ? ``` ### 6.4 Validation Rules | Field | Rule | Error key | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `period` | Required; regex `^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$`; must exist in Eurostat | `period` | | `period` on update | Immutable; the service ignores any submitted value and keeps the stored one | n/a | | `noteText` | Required after trim; 1 to 2000 characters | `noteText` | | `tag` | Required; one of `GENERAL`, `MILESTONE`, `ANOMALY`, `WATCH` | `tag` | | `rating` | Optional; integer 1 to 5 | `rating` | | `pinned` | Optional boolean; defaults to false | `pinned` | | Uniqueness | One note per period | `period` | ### 6.5 Java Data Contracts ```java public record EurostatObservation(String period, double unemploymentRatePct) {} public record EurostatMetadata(String datasetLabel, String datasetSource, String lastUpdated) {} public record EurostatSummary(long observationCount, String minPeriod, String maxPeriod, String latestPeriod) {} public record SeriesNote( long id, String period, String noteText, NoteTag tag, Integer rating, boolean pinned, OffsetDateTime createdAt, OffsetDateTime updatedAt) {} public enum NoteTag { GENERAL, MILESTONE, ANOMALY, WATCH } ``` `SeriesNoteForm` is a mutable class with getters and setters because Spring MVC binds form fields through JavaBeans properties. Data Design ### 6.1 Eurostat Read Model ```java public record EurostatSeries(String period, double unemploymentRatePct) {} ``` Queries: ```sql SELECT period, unemployment_rate_pct FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table ORDER BY period ``` ```sql SELECT period, unemployment_rate_pct FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table WHERE period = ? ``` ```sql SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table WHERE period = ? ``` ```sql SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table ``` ```sql SELECT 1 ``` The app loads all 356 rows and performs filtering, sorting, and pagination in Java. This avoids relying on `LIMIT`, `OFFSET`, or window functions that may not be supported by the Zetaris SQL surface. ### 6.2 In-Memory Note Model ```java public record SeriesNote( Long id, String period, String noteText, String tag, Integer rating, boolean pinned, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt) {} ``` Rules: - `id` is assigned by `AtomicLong` on create; never reused. - `period` matches `^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$` and must exist in Eurostat. - `period` is unique across notes. - `noteText` is non-blank and at most 2,000 characters. - `tag` is optional, at most 32 characters. - `rating` is optional; when present, 1–5. - `pinned` defaults to `false`. - `createdAt` is set once; `updatedAt` changes on every update. ### 6.3 In-Memory Repository Contract ```java public interface SeriesNoteRepository { List findAll(); Optional findById(long id); Optional findByPeriod(String period); boolean existsByPeriod(String period); SeriesNote save(SeriesNote note); void deleteById(long id); long count(); void clear(); } ``` Implementation notes: - `ConcurrentHashMap` for storage. - `AtomicLong` for ids. - `save` and `deleteById` are `synchronized` so the unique-period check and the map write are atomic. - `findAll` returns `List.copyOf(map.values())`; the service sorts the result. - `clear()` exists for tests and is not exposed through the UI. ### 6.4 Service Contracts `EurostatService`: - `List listAll()` — newest period first. - `Optional findByPeriod(String period)`. - `boolean existsByPeriod(String period)`. - `SeriesSummary summary()` — count, latest period/rate, earliest period/rate, average rate. - `PageResult page(int page, int size, String year)` — filters by year prefix, clamps page and size, returns a `PageResult`. - `int ping()` — `SELECT 1`. `SeriesNoteService`: - `List listAll()` — pinned first, then `updatedAt` descending. - `SeriesNote get(long id)` — throws `NoteNotFoundException`. - `SeriesNote create(SeriesNoteForm form)` — validates period and uniqueness. - `SeriesNote update(long id, SeriesNoteForm form)` — validates period and uniqueness. - `void delete(long id)` — throws `NoteNotFoundException`. - `Optional findByPeriod(String period)`. - `long count()`. ### 6.5 Validation Rules | Field | Rule | Error message | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `period` | Required; `^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$`; exists in Eurostat | "Period must be a valid month such as 2025-07." / "No Eurostat observation exists for this period." | | `noteText` | Required; 1–2,000 characters | "Note text is required." / "Note text must be at most 2000 characters." | | `tag` | Optional; at most 32 characters | "Tag must be at most 32 characters." | | `rating` | Optional; 1–5 | "Rating must be between 1 and 5." | | `pinned` | Boolean; defaults false | — | | Duplicate period | One note per period | "A note already exists for this period." | ### 6.6 Pagination Contract ```java public record PageResult( List items, int page, int size, long totalItems, int totalPages, boolean hasPrevious, boolean hasNext) {} ``` `page` is zero-based. `size` defaults to 25 and is clamped to 1–100. `page` is clamped to `[0, totalPages - 1]` when data exists; an empty result uses page `0` and `totalPages` `0`. *** ## 7. # Eurostat CRUD (Java)

A small Spring Boot web app that demonstrates the Zetaris Lightning JDBC
interface. It reads the Eurostat monthly unemployment series for Poland
directly over JDBC and keeps app-owned notes about individual observations
in memory.

## What it demonstrates

- A Zetaris JDBC driver loaded through `SimpleDriverDataSource`.
- A `JdbcTemplate` reading `eurostat.une_rt_m_pl_series_table`.
- Read-only Eurostat data: the app never writes to Zetaris.
- Local CRUD for notes: create, read, update, delete, pin, rate, and tag.
- Thymeleaf server-rendered pages, no frontend build step.
- A health endpoint that checks `SELECT 1` against Zetaris.

## Stack

- Java 21
- Spring Boot 4.1.2
- Maven
- Thymeleaf
- Zetaris Lightning JDBC driver `2.1.0.13`

## Prerequisites

- JDK 21 or newer (`java -version`).
- Maven 3.9 or newer (`mvn -version`).
- Network access to the Zetaris Lightning endpoint.
- The Zetaris JDBC driver JAR, for example
  `ndp-jdbc-driver-2.1.0.13-driver.jar`.

## Install the driver

The driver is not published to Maven Central. Install it into the local Maven
repository once:

```bash
./scripts/install-zetaris-driver.sh /path/to/ndp-jdbc-driver-2.1.0.13-driver.jar
```

Or set `ZETARIS_JDBC_JAR` and run the script without an argument:

```bash
ZETARIS_JDBC_JAR=/path/to/ndp-jdbc-driver-2.1.0.13-driver.jar \
  ./scripts/install-zetaris-driver.sh
```

This installs `com.zetaris:lightning-jdbc:2.1.0.13-local` locally.

## Configure

The app reads three environment variables. Put them in the repository's
`.env.local` file, which is gitignored:

```dotenv
ZETARIS_JDBC_URL=jdbc:zetaris:lightning@your-host:10000
ZETARIS_USERNAME=your-user
ZETARIS_PASSWORD=your-password
```

Do not commit this file. `run.sh` sources `../../.env.local` automatically.

## Run

```bash
./run.sh
```

Then open:

- <http://127.0.0.1:8090/> — dashboard
- <http://127.0.0.1:8090/series> — Eurostat observations
- <http://127.0.0.1:8090/notes> — app notes
- <http://127.0.0.1:8090/health> — Zetaris health check

The server binds to `127.0.0.1:8090` only. It has no authentication and is
intended for local demonstration.

## CRUD behavior

- **Create**: a note must reference an existing Eurostat period. One note per
  period.
- **Read**: notes appear on the dashboard, on the notes page, and on the
  matching series detail page.
- **Update**: edit the note text, tag, rating, or pinned flag. The period can
  change only to another existing Eurostat period with no note.
- **Delete**: removes the note from memory.
- **Seed data**: three notes are created at startup (`1997-01`, `2024-01`,
  `2025-07`). They disappear when the app stops.

## Tests

```bash
mvn test
```

Runs unit and MockMvc tests. They do not need a live Zetaris endpoint.

```bash
set -a
source ../../.env.local
set +a
mvn verify
```

`EurostatJdbcIT` is enabled only when `ZETARIS_JDBC_URL` is set. It reads the
real Eurostat table and checks `/health`.

## Design notes

- Notes live in a `ConcurrentHashMap`; there is no H2 or JPA layer.
- The app uses one `DataSource` and one `JdbcTemplate`, both named for Zetaris.
- The Zetaris password is read from the environment and is never logged or
  committed.
- `spring.thymeleaf.cache=false` keeps template edits visible during local
  development.

## Limitations

- Notes are not durable. Restarting the app resets them to the three seed
  notes.
- The app is a single-user local demo; there is no authentication or CSRF
  protection.
- The Eurostat table is read-only. Writes are deliberately out of scope.
